Title: Staff Distributed Systems Engineer
Company: Apex Cloud Systems
Location: London, UK (Hybrid)

About the Role:
Apex Cloud Systems is seeking a Staff Distributed Systems Engineer to lead the design and execution of our global streaming fabric.

Responsibilities:
- Architect and scale real-time event streaming systems handling over 10M events/day.
- Optimize distributed storage and caching using PostgreSQL, Kafka, and Redis.
- Maintain high resilience and 99.999% availability across multi-region deployments.

Requirements:
- 5+ years of production experience with Go and Python in distributed systems.
- Demonstrated experience tuning systems for sub-10ms p99 latency.
- Deep expertise in PostgreSQL indexing, query planning, and replication.
- Production experience with Kafka consumer groups and Redis clustering.
